before_behavior: Step 10 reads: 'After archiving: invoke modules/l5/nexus/scripts/graph-builder.py --scope {changed-files} for dependency edges only. If Nexus graph does not exist yet (first archive run): skip and record nexus_refreshed: false. Do not fail archiving because Nexus has not been initialized.' graph-builder.py is invoked after every archive run regardless of whether any framework-relevant files were changed.
after_behavior: Step 10 adds a pre-check before invoking graph-builder.py. Archive collects the union of files_written fields across all wave receipts for this session. It checks whether any entry matches a framework-graph-relevant pattern: (a) path starts with 'modules/' and ends with 'SKILL.md' or 'skill-rules.json'; (b) path starts with '_shared/schemas/' and ends with '.json'; (c) exact match 'framework.yaml'. If no file matches: record nexus_refreshed: false, nexus_skip_reason: 'no-framework-files-modified' and skip graph-builder.py. If any file matches: invoke graph-builder.py as before. The nexus_skip_reason field is null when nexus_refreshed=true. This field is additive to the delivery receipt schema.

benchmark_gates.rationale: A Nexus graph drift event is defined as: a session where a framework file was modified, archive ran, nexus_refreshed was recorded as false (incorrectly skipped), and the resulting stale edge was later detected by Guard. The threshold is 0.0 — the conditional skip must never suppress a legitimate refresh. The pattern-match logic is deterministic: if a framework file appears in files_written, it matches the pattern and triggers refresh. No drift is acceptable.

fixture_spec.developer_scenario: A documentation-only task delivers CHANGELOG.md and README.md. No framework files touched. Archive step 10 pre-check finds no framework-pattern matches in files_written. graph-builder.py is not invoked. nexus_refreshed=false, nexus_skip_reason='no-framework-files-modified'. A separate task delivers modules/l3/cli/SKILL.md. Pre-check finds a match. graph-builder.py is invoked. nexus_refreshed=true.

notes: The nexus_skip_reason field is additive — it does not break existing delivery receipt consumers. Existing receipts have nexus_refreshed: true or nexus_refreshed: false with no nexus_skip_reason (null is the default). The pattern-match logic covers all known framework-graph-relevant paths. If new framework paths are added in future (e.g., a new shared schema directory), the pattern list in step 10 must be updated.
